items.source: This endpoint must provide the requested missing option(s) of the specified container to make it usable. Usually, this is about setting the destination and the messageListener to use but an implementation may override any default setting that was already set.
items.translation: 此端点必须提供指定容器的所需缺失选项，使其可用。通常，这涉及设置要使用的 `destination`` 和 `messageListener``，但实现可以覆盖任何已设置的默认值。

items.source:
The concurrency limits can be a "lower-upper" String, for example, "5-10", or a simple
upper limit String, for example, "10" (the lower limit will be 1 in this case).
items.translation: 并发限制可以是“下限 - 上限”形式的字符串，例如"5-10"，也可以是简单的上限字符串，例如"10"（在这种情况下，下限将为 1）。

items.source:
The underlying container may or may not support all features. For instance, it
may not be able to scale: in that case only the upper value is used.
items.translation: 底层容器可能不支持所有功能。例如，它可能无法进行扩展：在这种情况下，仅使用上限值。
